EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Rain in the morning is such a fresh
way to start the day,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} don't you
think, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Pour un matin bien frais, rien de tel
qu'une petite pluie.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} Enfin, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}c'est mon
avis, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Regen am Morgen vertreibt Kummer
und Sorgen. {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Meinst du nicht,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sabah yağmuru güne başlamanın
ne kadar ferah bir yolu,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} sence de öyle değil
mi, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Holita{{TAG:0007:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} 
El día de hoy me recuerda a la
novela que estuve leyendo anoche.
¿No te gustaría ser {{TAG:000E:0006:040065006C0004006C006100}} protagonista
de una novela? ¡Sería tan
emocionante,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Cómo llueve...{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Si la cosa empeora
vente a mi casa. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Tengo magdalenas
recién horneadas,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Mi chiedo per quanto continuerà a
piovere.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Forse smetterà prima
di sera, chissà,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Acaba daha ne kadar yağacak.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Belki
geceye kadar diner,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Tiens, ravie de te revoir{{TAG:0007:0007:}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}De la pluie de bon matin, c'est le
signe que la journée sera grandiose,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Contente de te revoir, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Ce serait un crime de rester cloîtré
à l'intérieur par ce temps, parole de
grenouille !{{TAG:0003:0026:}} {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Che gioia vederti in giro!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0003:}}Sarebbe
un peccato starsene a casa con
questa bella pioggia,{{TAG:0003:0026:}} {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Schön, dass du bei diesem Wetter
draußen herumläufst!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0003:}}Ist doch toll,
dieser Regen,{{TAG:0003:0026:}} {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Seni dışarıda görmek güzel!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0003:}}Yağmur
yağıyor diye evde kalmak yazık
olurdu,{{TAG:0003:0026:}} {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}All the walking I've been doing
today{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} has my feet all soaked and
wrinkly,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Estaba tan emocionada jugando,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡que me he puesto perdida de barro
sin darme cuenta,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Ho passeggiato troppo sotto
la pioggia oggi {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}e ora ho le zampe
zuppe,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Wo ich heute schon überall
herumgelaufen bin.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} Meine Füße
sind ganz nass,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Bugün o kadar çok yürüdüm ki{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} ayaklarım
sırılsıklam olup buruştu,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Yine merhaba,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}Seninle
konuşunca tepeden tırnağa ıslandığımı
biraz unutuyorum.

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Questa pioggia non la smette più!
{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Dobbiamo fare del nostro meglio
per essere solari,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dieser Regen will einfach nicht
aufhören!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}Da braucht man ein
sonniges Gemüt,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Good to see you again!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Rain makes
me feel so warm inside.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Like a cake
right out of the oven!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Seni yine görmek güzel!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Yağmur içimi
sıcacık yapıyor.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Fırından yeni
çıkmış kek gibi!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I never thought I'd meet someone
who likes strolling on rainy nights as
much as I do, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Pensaba que era la única a la que
le gustaba salir de noche mientras
llueve, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Non avrei mai pensato di incontrare
qualcuno a cui piace passeggiare
a quest'ora sotto la pioggia...
... tanto quanto me, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ich hätte nie gedacht, dass noch
jemand so gerne im Regen spaziert
wie ich, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yağmurlu gecelerde dolaşmayı benim
kadar seven biriyle karşılaşacağımı hiç
düşünmezdim, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}This rain is going to make the town
all clean and shiny,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La lluvia puede ser pesada, pero
es muy necesaria,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Avec cette pluie, la ville va être
toute propre et brillante !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Questa pioggia renderà la città
pulita e splendente,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Der Regen sorgt dafür, dass unser
Dorf wieder funkelt und blitzt.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Und
die Luft ist so klar,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bu yağmur bütün kasabayı tertemiz
ve pırıl pırıl yapacak,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Sometimes I like to close my eyes
and just listen to the sound of the
rain!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}It's so tranquil,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}A veces cierro los ojos y me dedico
a escuchar la lluvia.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}} ¡Es como una
poesía,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Tu sais, j'aime bien fermer les yeux
et écouter la pluie...{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}C'est encore
mieux qu'un CD de musique zen !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Manchmal schließe ich die Augen
und höre nur dem Regen zu!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Oh,
wie schön,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Bazen gözlerimi kapatıp yalnızca
yağmurun sesini dinlemeyi seviyorum!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}İnsanın içini ne kadar huzurla
dolduruyor,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}What could you possibly need to do
at this hour?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}You have so much
energy,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Was hast du denn um diese Uhrzeit
noch vor?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Du musst ja Energie
haben,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bu saatte yapacak ne işin olabilir?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Enerjin hiç bitmiyor,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Hee hee hee!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Nights like tonight
make me want to throw away all
the umbrellas in town{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}and make everyone {{TAG:0003:002A:}}tap-dance in
the rain with me,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Eh eh eh eh!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}In notti come questa,
mi viene voglia di nascondere tutti
gli ombrelli e{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}... costringere gli amici{{TAG:0003:002A:}} a ballare
insieme il tip tap sotto la pioggia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Hihihi!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Böyle gecelerde kasabadaki bütün
şemsiyeleri toplayıp atmak{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. {{TAG:0003:0003:}}sonra
da herkesi benimle yağmurda {{TAG:0003:002A:}}step yapmaya
zorlamak istiyorum,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Re-coucou{{TAG:0007:0007:}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Tu aimes observer les étoiles, toi,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}} ? {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Moi, bof...
Je préfère largement quand elles
sont cachées par de gros nuages
gorgés de pluie,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
